Binance Invests $100 Million in Circle, Expands Partnership

Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has invested $100 million in Circle, a rival issuer of the USDC stablecoin. The investment also includes an expansion of their existing partnership. This move signifies a strategic alignment between the two entities in the digital currency space.
